response.description:
In mid-November 2026, the following updates and
enhancements were made to Azure SQL:   
 Fuzzy
     string matching enables you to compare strings based on similarity rather
     than relying only on exact matches. Using built-in functions, you can
     measure the difference or similarity between strings with algorithms such
     as Damerau-Levenshtein (OSA) and Jaro-Winkler. 
 Regex-based
     Dynamic Data Masking extends the built-in DDM feature in Azure SQL
     Database with flexible, pattern-based masking using regular
     expressions—centrally enforced at the database layer. 
 AES
     keys support for Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) with customer-managed
     keys in Azure SQL Database are now generally available, providing an
     alternative to RSA keys for protecting data at rest and helping you
     prepare for the evolving quantum threat landscape. 
 You
     can now customize how numeric values appear in the SSMS results grid
     without changing your queries or Windows regional settings. Choose your
     preferred digit grouping and decimal symbols, or use your system defaults.
     A live preview shows how your selections will look, and changes apply to
     open grids without restarting SSMS or rerunning your query. Learn more: Fuzzy string matchingRegex-based

response.title: Generally Available: Azure SQL updates for mid-November 2026
